comparator.name: Entrepreneurship and Business Innovation
comparator.sourceNotes: The current official curriculum totals 180 ECTS. The first two years each contain 60 ECTS combining entrepreneurship, innovation, business foundations, quantitative methods and four successive Entrepreneurship in Action projects. Year 3 contains a 30-ECTS mobility/minor/internship window, Philosophy for Business, a 12-ECTS graduation project, one 6-ECTS specialisation choice and one 6-ECTS elective. Zero-credit GROW activity is excluded. The specialisation and elective components remain genuine choices rather than being populated with assumed courses.
